items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Stand in front of Jeff Hamilton or somebody like that

ctx.x: And I said, “Art Blakey.” And he said, “Go get him. He’s the guy.” And you know he might be right because I realize now that for many years I’d stand and play in front of the drummer. I shouldn’t have, but I did. I might have like the idea of the beat and the feeling if he’s a good drummer, I liked, you know. Stand in front of Jeff Hamilton or somebody like that, or even those days Art Blakey. But I shouldn’t have because the sound of the drums and the cymbals, they wash over you. And it might have started that.…
